task: Expand ODT dashboard state coverage: deep+wide sweep of uncovered states
rules_summary: Include only systems meeting index.html Reference-tab scope rules: same-day app/phone booking with no fixed schedule; OR advance-window demand-response open to general public; OR confirmed-vendor+funding planned/pilot. Paratransit (eligibility-restricted) allowed as its own System Type. Exclude 24h+ advance-only, private/employer/campus-only, permanently discontinued. Verify every candidate before adding; log gaps/uncertainties in concerns.csv.
notes: Batch 1 (AL/AK/AR): 13 systems added. Note: args reached workflow as a JSON string, so the run merged all 3 states into one pipeline item; agents still covered all three. Script fixed to parse string args for focused per-state runs going forward.

Batch 2 (DE/HI/IA): 25 systems added (DE 2, HI 6, IA 17). Improved assembler dedup to strip diacritics + leading 'The' (caught Hawaiian ʻokina/kahakō dupes); dropped one DE semantic dupe (DART Paratransit == DART First State Paratransit). IA is legitimately large (~16 regional transit agencies).
